title: Industrial Shopfloor Reliability, Quality & EHS Safety Configuration

org_configured.description: True once Industrial Shopfloor Reliability, Quality & EHS Safety organization thresholds and connectors are configured.

organization_name.description: Tenant legal entity or department name.

sheet_map.description: Optional mapping from canonical table key (e.g. invoices) to customer worksheet tab name.

column_map.description: Optional mapping from customer column header or connector JSON field name to canonical engine field name.

service_level_z.description: Z-score for spare parts safety stock (1.65 = ~95% service level).

max_capex_payback_years.description: Maximum CapEx payback horizon in years.

lot_spike_multiplier.description: Ratio over plant lot scrap average triggering supplier containment alert.

max_lel_pct.description: Maximum permitted Lower Explosive Limit % for confined-space entry.

max_gas_test_age_mins.description: Maximum elapsed minutes since atmospheric gas test.
